velocity_breadth_router.measurement_time: the causal raw-turn snapshot, before maturation or entry
velocity_breadth_router.measurement: count observed CL horizons whose slope_velocity_pct_per_bar sign agrees with the raw-turn direction
velocity_breadth_router.primary: for a raw matched-MCL response of one to three ticks, follow with three or more aligned horizon velocities and fade with fewer than three
velocity_breadth_router.large_response: responses above three ticks remain failed-auction fades regardless of velocity breadth
velocity_breadth_router.admission: every unchanged v13 admission remains an admission; only routed direction may differ

selection_law: three aligned velocities is the declared primary; two/four are sensitivity neighbors and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes
prohibitions: no abstention, daily quota, or synthetic re-entry
no change to profit-memory activation or retention
no stop, target, timeout, session, direction, volatility, calendar, or news interaction
no crown or live authority from exposed history
